title: DimensionAssessment
description: AI-produced, advisory assessment of one role-scoped compatibility dimension. There are no bare scores: every score carries confidence and the admitted evidence lineage it consumed. The Decision Authority reasons over (evidence, confidence), not score alone.

dimension.description: Role-scoped dimension id, e.g. TECHNICAL, OPERATING_ENVIRONMENT_COMPATIBILITY.

outcome.description: SCORED when required evidence admitted AND confidence >= RCP floor; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

score.description: Present only when outcome==SCORED. Null when INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

confidence.description: How much the assessor trusts this dimension's score. Low confidence is a request for more evidence, never a reason to lower the score.

evidence.description: Admitted evidence items cited for this dimension, by lineage node.

lineage_node_id.description: Evidence Lineage DAG node this claim consumed.

reason_codes.description: Structured, controlled-vocabulary reasons supporting the outcome.

gaps.description: What evidence, if admitted, would raise confidence or resolve INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

advisory_only.description: Hard invariant: a dimension assessment is advisory and can never be a decision.
